preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.split() if line.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All coordinates (C and P_i) are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(P_i != C for P_i in P) and len(set(P)) == len(P)
preconditions.description: All P_i are distinct and none equal to C (P_i ≠ C, P_i ≠ P_j for i ≠ j).
Number of test cases T ≥ 1, and officers N ≥ 1 per test case.

postconditions.description: Output is two space-separated integers: max_eliminated (maximum officers eliminated) and runs_away (1 if Chef runs away, -1 if caught).

postconditions.expression: max_eliminated == len(P) - min_remaining and (runs_away == 1 if min_remaining == 0 else runs_away == -1)
postconditions.description: max_eliminated is the maximum officers eliminated (len(P) - min_remaining), and runs_away is 1 if all officers are eliminated (min_remaining = 0), else -1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= max_eliminated <= len(P) for max_eliminated in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()])
postconditions.description: max_eliminated is a non-negative integer ≤ N (number of officers).

postconditions.expression: all(runs_away in {1, -1} for runs_away in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()])
postconditions.description: runs_away is either 1 (Chef runs away) or -1 (Chef is caught).
